payload.build_record:
THE CHUNK MACHINE'S RUN. Twelve chunks, eleven filled, one blocked. Every chunk that landed is a PROMOTION COMMIT in trunk with a green suite behind it, which makes this record checkable rather than narrative.

ACTOR: agent, for every chunk. The owner ruled the ORDER (the injection first, then the rewalk) and intervened four times during the build; both are recorded per chunk where they changed something.

THE PROMOTIONS, in order, each with its verified suite result IN TRUNK:
  6cfddf0 — 31 files, 216 passed / 0 failed. C1 injection, C2 reopen, C3 search, C4 read/glob/batch, C5 guards, C6 lints, C7 config, C8 record durability, C9 promotion itself. The bootstrap: promotion cannot promote itself the first time, so this one ran the real implementation from a script, declared.
  b91bc8e — 2 files, 220 passed / 0 failed. C2 repair one: reopen no longer strands a downstream join.
  c30f023 — 3 files, 221 passed / 0 failed. C2 repair two: a reopened state no longer re-activates itself. Plus C9 repair: the suite runner no longer inherits the live session's admission.
  5adfe2b — 10 files, 222 passed / 0 failed. C10 console-window sweep, sixteen call sites plus the lint.
  dda426e — 1 file, 226 passed / 0 failed. C11 fitness properties.

C12 THE APPLICABILITY JOIN — NOT FILLED. Blocked on a decision that does not exist: the selector vocabulary, whose spike did not run. Recorded as blocked rather than omitted, because an undrawn chunk reads as work nobody wanted.

WHAT THE RUN ACTUALLY LOOKED LIKE, since a build record that reads as a clean sequence would be false. Five promotion refusals, none about the code being promoted:
  dependencies installed before the manifest that declared them, so the suite resolved against the old one;
  the runner handed a DIRECTORY to the test runner, which resolved it as a module and died, counted as one failing test named after the directory — three refusals blaming healthy code;
  the commit message written to a path that is not always a directory;
  the suite inheriting the live session's admission, so a test asserting that an unadmitted call is refused saw an admitted world.
And two live deadlocks of the machine itself, both silent, the second introduced by the fix for the first.

PARALLELISM: none used. Every chunk ran sequentially by one actor. C3, C4, C7 and C8 are mutually independent and could have fanned out to sub-agents; they did not, because the engine promotion that makes parallel agents safe was itself one of the chunks being built. Recording that as a fact about this run rather than as a limitation of the design — the next iteration can fan out, and this one built the thing that lets it.

SUB-RECORD FILE: none. The chunk machine was seeded in the plan rather than as a drawn sub-machine, so the chunks are recorded here and in the promotion commits rather than in a separate instance file. That is the accepted debt named at the previous iteration's ship — the mechanical build-steps guard is still a follow-up, and this iteration did not close it.

WHAT THE CHUNKING BOUGHT, measured: eleven interruptions across this build — two deadlocks, five refusals, one reconnect, three owner interventions that changed the work. Not one lost completed work, because every unit was small enough to finish, verify and promote alone.
